accumulation_events.description: Series of events that mark the transition from downtrend to uptrend as smart money absorbs supply

PS.name: Preliminary Support
PS.description: First sign that buying is beginning to slow the prior downtrend. Not the final low but indicates demand is entering.
PS.volume_characteristic: volume increases; spread widens on down bar but buyers beginning to appear
PS.price_action: price declines into area; closes off lows; signs of buying interest

SC.name: Selling Climax
SC.description: Panic selling at the end of the downtrend. High volume bar with wide spread closing in lower half. Marks exhaustion of sellers.
SC.volume_characteristic: extremely high volume; highest in the move; climactic
SC.price_action: wide range down bar; close in lower portion; often a spike low
SC.location_in_phase: critical — defines potential bottom of accumulation range
SC.trade_note: do not buy the SC bar itself; wait for the Automatic Rally and then the Secondary Test

AR.name: Automatic Rally
AR.description: Sharp rally after the Selling Climax as short sellers cover and fresh buyers enter into the vacuum left by climactic selling.
AR.volume_characteristic: volume decreases relative to SC; still above average
AR.price_action: sharp bounce from SC low; defines the top of the accumulation trading range
AR.location_in_phase: defines the upper boundary of the accumulation range
AR.trade_note: AR high becomes the resistance line of the trading range

ST.name: Secondary Test
ST.description: Price returns to the area of the Selling Climax to test the supply/demand balance at that level. Lower volume and narrower spread confirm supply is diminishing.
ST.volume_characteristic: volume significantly less than SC; should be noticeably lower
ST.price_action: price revisits SC area; may slightly undercut SC low; closes in upper half
ST.location_in_phase: confirms SC was a genuine climax; validates accumulation potential
ST.trade_note: ST on lower volume confirms SC was valid; multiple STs are possible

spring.name: Spring
spring.description: False breakdown below the support of the accumulation trading range (below SC/ST lows). Shakes out weak longs and triggers stop orders before the markup. Smart money buys the spring.
spring.volume_characteristic: low to moderate on the break; volume should NOT confirm the breakdown
spring.price_action: price dips below support briefly; quickly reverses and closes back within range

spring_types.type_1: Major spring — price drops well below support on high volume; rare but very bullish if quickly reversed
spring_types.type_2: Minor spring — price barely breaks support on low volume; most common
spring_types.type_3: No spring — price never breaks support; accumulation ends with an upside breakout directly

trade_setup.entry: long on close back above prior support or on first Higher Low after the spring
trade_setup.target: AR high minimum; beyond for full markup targets

test_of_spring.name: Test of Spring
test_of_spring.description: Price returns to the area of the spring low to confirm that supply has been absorbed. Low volume test confirms the spring was successful.
test_of_spring.volume_characteristic: very low volume on the test; dry-up of supply
test_of_spring.price_action: price approaches spring low area; does not break below; reverses
test_of_spring.trade_note: Low volume test of spring low is one of the highest probability long entries in Wyckoff

SOS.name: Sign of Strength
SOS.description: A rally that breaks above the AR high (top of trading range) on expanding volume. Confirms that demand has overcome supply and markup is beginning.
SOS.volume_characteristic: volume expands significantly; highest volume seen in accumulation range
SOS.price_action: price closes above AR high; wide spread up bar; closes near high of bar
SOS.trade_note: SOS is the breakout signal; best entry is on the LPS pullback after SOS

LPS.name: Last Point of Support
LPS.description: The pullback after the Sign of Strength (SOS). Price returns to test the former resistance (AR high) which now acts as support. Low volume pullback confirms buyers are in control.
LPS.volume_characteristic: volume dries up on pullback; spread narrows
LPS.price_action: price pulls back to former resistance; holds above it; reversal candle or HL forms
LPS.location_in_phase: confirms accumulation complete; start of markup

trade_setup.entry: long at LPS level on sign of reversal
trade_setup.target: measured move from accumulation range depth projected from breakout

distribution_events.description: Series of events that mark the transition from uptrend to downtrend as smart money distributes holdings to the public

PSY.name: Preliminary Supply
PSY.description: First sign that selling is beginning to slow the prior uptrend. Large operators begin selling into strength. Not the final top but indicates supply is entering.
PSY.volume_characteristic: volume increases on the up bar; spread widens but selling pressure building
PSY.price_action: price rallies into area; closes off highs; signs of selling pressure

BC.name: Buying Climax
BC.description: Climactic buying at the end of the uptrend. High volume bar with wide spread closing in upper half. Marks exhaustion of buyers. Smart money sells aggressively into public buying.
BC.volume_characteristic: extremely high volume; highest in the move; climactic
BC.price_action: wide range up bar; close in upper portion; often a spike high
BC.location_in_phase: critical — defines potential top of distribution range
BC.trade_note: do not short the BC bar itself; wait for the Automatic Reaction and then the Secondary Test

AR_dist.name: Automatic Reaction
AR_dist.description: Sharp decline after the Buying Climax as buyers step back and sellers overwhelm. Defines the lower boundary of the distribution range.
AR_dist.volume_characteristic: volume decreases relative to BC; still above average
AR_dist.price_action: sharp decline from BC high; defines the bottom of the distribution trading range
AR_dist.location_in_phase: defines the lower boundary of the distribution range
AR_dist.trade_note: AR low becomes the support line of the trading range

ST_dist.name: Secondary Test
ST_dist.description: Price returns to the area of the Buying Climax to test the supply/demand balance. Lower volume and narrower spread confirm demand is fading.
ST_dist.volume_characteristic: volume significantly less than BC; should be noticeably lower
ST_dist.price_action: price revisits BC area; may slightly exceed BC high; closes in lower half
ST_dist.location_in_phase: confirms BC was a genuine climax; validates distribution potential

UTAD.name: Upthrust After Distribution
UTAD.description: False breakout above the resistance of the distribution trading range. Traps breakout buyers and provides smart money with final opportunity to sell/short at high prices before markdown.
UTAD.volume_characteristic: low to moderate on the break; volume should NOT confirm the breakout
UTAD.price_action: price spikes above resistance briefly; quickly reverses and closes back within range

trade_setup.entry: short on close back below prior resistance or on first Lower High after UTAD
trade_setup.target: AR low minimum; below for full markdown targets

SOW.name: Sign of Weakness
SOW.description: A decline that breaks below the AR low (bottom of trading range) on expanding volume. Confirms that supply has overcome demand and markdown is beginning.
SOW.volume_characteristic: volume expands significantly on the decline
SOW.price_action: price closes below AR low; wide spread down bar; closes near low of bar
SOW.trade_note: SOW is the breakdown signal; best entry is on the LPSY rally after SOW

LPSY.name: Last Point of Supply
LPSY.description: The rally after the Sign of Weakness (SOW). Price returns to test the former support (AR low) which now acts as resistance. Low volume rally confirms sellers are in control.
LPSY.volume_characteristic: volume dries up on rally; spread narrows
LPSY.price_action: price rallies to former support; rejected; reversal candle or LH forms
LPSY.location_in_phase: confirms distribution complete; start of markdown

trade_setup.entry: short at LPSY level on sign of rejection
trade_setup.target: measured move from distribution range depth projected from breakdown

general_rules: Effort (volume) should match result (price move); divergence signals weakness
High volume with little price progress indicates absorption by the opposing force
Low volume pullbacks in the direction of smart money confirm they are not selling/buying against the position
Volume dry-up at key levels (test of spring, LPS, LPSY) are the highest probability trade locations

agent_rules.condition: climactic high volume bar with wide spread appears after a prolonged trend
agent_rules.action: identify as potential SC (downtrend) or BC (uptrend); mark the low/high; do not trade the bar itself; wait for AR formation

agent_rules.condition: AR forms after SC or BC
agent_rules.action: mark AR high/low as the range boundary; wait for ST to validate climax

agent_rules.condition: ST occurs on volume lower than SC/BC
agent_rules.action: confirm climax validity; prepare for spring (accumulation) or UTAD (distribution) setup

agent_rules.condition: price breaks below accumulation range support on low volume and reverses quickly
agent_rules.action: classify as spring; enter long on reclaim of support; stop below spring low

agent_rules.condition: price breaks above distribution range resistance on low volume and reverses quickly
agent_rules.action: classify as UTAD; enter short on return below resistance; stop above UTAD high

agent_rules.condition: SOS breakout above accumulation range with volume expansion
agent_rules.action: confirm accumulation complete; wait for LPS pullback for long entry; stop below LPS

agent_rules.condition: SOW breakdown below distribution range with volume expansion
agent_rules.action: confirm distribution complete; wait for LPSY rally for short entry; stop above LPSY

agent_rules.condition: high volume with little price progress at range extremes
agent_rules.action: classify as absorption; smart money absorbing supply (at support) or demand (at resistance); prepare for reversal in range

agent_rules.condition: low volume test of spring low or LPS area
agent_rules.action: highest probability long entry in accumulation; enter long; tight stop below test low
